question: Where is the closest garden relative to the north of Appalachian Wireless Arena, Pikeville, KY?
sql: WITH arena_location AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Appalachian Wireless Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Pikeville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), all_gardens AS ( SELECT id, poi_name AS name, geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'garden' UNION ALL SELECT id, park_name AS name, geometry AS geom FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'garden' ) SELECT g.name, ST_Distance(g.geom::geography, al.geom::geography) AS distance_meters FROM all_gardens AS g, arena_location AS al WHERE ST_Y(ST_Centroid(g.geom)) > ST_Y(ST_Centroid(al.geom)) -- Filter for gardens north of the arena ORDER BY ST_Distance(g.geom::geography, al.geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
